answer: Locks are published in crystal, expire in lantern, and haven lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 198 aliases therefore needs 27 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1095 identities would post 3454 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
